title: Design Artifact
description: Pre-execution design commitment required before any .cs modifications in src/net/. V153 validates this artifact before sprint execution.

taskcard_id.description: TC-* taskcard ID owning this change

language.description: Must be 'dotnet' — Python artifacts not covered here

target_file.description: Target .cs file path relative to repo root. Must start with src/net/

is_partial_class.description: Whether this class uses the 'partial' keyword. V153 FAILS if true for new domain types.

spec_qname.description: ODF/format QName this class represents (e.g. table:table-cell)

estimated_loc.description: Estimated lines of code. Must be > 10 and < 800 (V78 cap).

public_api.description: List of public API members this change will add

name.description: C# method or property name (e.g. GetCellFormula)

parser_source.description: Where the parser reads this value (e.g. XElement.Attribute('office:value'))

writer_path.description: How mutations reach XML (e.g. SetAttributeValue('office:value', val))

has_xml_doc.description: Whether this member has an XML documentation comment (<summary>)

no_dictionary_state.description: Commit: this change introduces no private Dictionary fields. V153 FAILS if false.

no_constant_returns.description: Commit: no public getter returns a constant. V153 FAILS if false.
